map.输入真皮目标温度与维持时间，评估胶原收缩与紧肤效果: Enter the target dermal temperature and hold time to assess collagen contraction and skin-tightening effect.

map.胶原收缩率按真皮温度分段；收缩率 = min(分段值 × 时间因子, 55%)；: Collagen contraction rate is segmented by dermal temperature; contraction rate = min(segment value × time factor, 55%); time factor = min(1 + 0.3 × ln(time), 1.8)
map.收缩率分段：<45 ℃ 为 0；45–55 ℃ 为 (T − 45)/10 ×: Contraction segments: <45 °C = 0; 45–55 °C = (T − 45)/10 × 10; 55–60 °C = 10 + (T − 55)/5 × 10; 60–70 °C = 20 + (T − 60)/10 × 25; 70–75 °C = 45 + (T − 70)/5 × 5; ≥75 °C capped at 50%. Effect grading: <45 none, <55 slight, <65 good, <75 marked, ≥75 risk zone. Used to quantify RF / thermal collagen contraction and skin-tightening effect.
map.💡 胶原收缩始于约 55-60℃；60-70℃ 可达 30-50% 收缩率，超过: 💡 Collagen contraction starts around 55–60 °C; 60–70 °C can reach 30–50% contraction; above 75 °C carries thermal-injury risk.
map.射频治疗属医疗操作，参数须由专业医师根据设备设定: RF treatment is a medical procedure; parameters must be set by a licensed physician per device.
map.📚 深度解析：射频紧肤效果评估: 📚 Deep Dive: RF Skin-Tightening Effect Assessment
map.居家射频科普：理解家用低频低能为何需长期坚持、机构为何更快。: Home RF education: understand why low-frequency, low-energy home devices need long-term use and why clinics are faster.
map.风险识别：长时间同一处停留的烫伤风险。: Risk awareness: burn risk from staying too long at one spot.
map.疗效复盘：按温度时间记录判断是否达到刺激窗。: Efficacy review: use temperature-time logs to judge whether the stimulation window was reached.
map.输入：表皮 38–40℃、每区 3 分钟、每周 3 次 → 温和维持级，需长期；: Input: epidermis 38–40 °C, 3 min per zone, 3× weekly → gentle maintenance level, needs long-term use; marked laxity still warrants clinic assessment.
map.家用能替代机构吗？: Can home use replace the clinic?
map.难。能量与深度有限，严重松弛靠专业设备。: Hard. Energy and depth are limited; severe laxity needs professional devices.
map.不是。同点久停易烫伤，按说明移动。: No. Lingering at one spot risks burns; keep it moving per instructions.

map.不作。具体方案听医师。: No. Follow your physician for the specific plan.
